name: cognitive-os
description: Portable decision layer for maturing consequential decisions, with capability discovery and optional privacy-preserving diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Think before you spec. Decide before you execute.
interface.longDescription: Mature consequential decisions before execution by separating evidence from assumptions, challenging the leading conclusion, discovering missing capabilities, and identifying the next useful proof.
defaultPrompt: Use Cognitive OS to help me decide whether this idea is worth pursuing before I build it.
Use Cognitive OS to challenge this recommendation and tell me what evidence would change the decision.
Use Cognitive OS to identify a missing capability and discover an appropriate skill or MCP without installing an unreviewed candidate.
